correction.scope: root-cause wording and protected mount facts only
correction.previousStatement: the broker mounted /tmp as a 16 MiB noexec tmpfs
correction.correctedStatement: the broker mounts /tmp at 2 GiB; the 16 MiB limit is --shm-size on /dev/shm, used as GOTMPDIR for pre-measurement Go links before the evaluator's 512 MiB per-repetition remount

authorization.ruling: record blocked; no additional evaluator design change in this lane

blocker.exactFailure:
go: # github.com/evanw/esbuild/internal/bundler_tests.test
/usr/local/go/pkg/tool/linux_amd64/link: mapping output file failed: no space left on device
blocker.rootCause: The protected evaluator invokes Go with GOTMPDIR=/dev/shm while linking upstream test binaries and the candidate before measurement. The broker mounts /tmp at 2 GiB but starts the container with --shm-size 16m, so the pre-measurement linker scratch is limited by the 16 MiB /dev/shm. FRESH_TMPFS_OPTIONS remounts /dev/shm at 512 MiB only before each timed bundle, after those Go links, so the authorized constant migration cannot increase the failing linker scratch capacity.

protectedBoundary.timedRepetitionShm: 512m,nosuid,nodev; mounted only after upstream tests and candidate build

blocker.requiredDecision: A future dedicated evaluator-design lane must separately size the pre-measurement Go linker scratch or refresh it before the links without weakening the broker scratch contract. This lane is not authorized to change evaluator logic or runtime mount design.
blocker.historicalArm64Evidence: retained with its original architecture label; not relabelled as AMD64
